_doc: Terminus kind for the loop -1 min rule. Trolleybuses cannot reverse, so every terminus is a turn: a turning loop, a bus-station circuit or a block. The Prague tram sheet counts block loops as loops (Březiněveská), so all trolleybus termini here are kind=loop: departures set 1 min early. The arrival and departure stands are from PID GTFS stops.txt (platform_code); in every case the trolleybus arrives at one stand and leaves from another.

Palmovka.description: arrives at stand F, turns, departs from stand D

Miškovice.description: arrives at stand A, turns off-wire, departs from stand B

Čakovice.description: arrives at stand F (alighting continues to stand B), turns off-wire, departs from stand C

Na Knížecí.description: bus station: arrives at stand V, departs from stand O

Waltrovka.description: arrives at stand C, turns, departs from stand D on the other side of the street

Jinonice.description: arrives at stand L, turns off-wire, departs from stand B

Nádraží Veleslavín.description: bus terminal: arrives at stand V, departs from stand 2

Terminál 1.description: airport one-way circuit: the trip ends at Letiště (stand A, after Terminál 1 C and Terminál 2 C); the trolleybus departs from Terminál 1 stand E. Letiště is merged into Terminál 1 (stop_aliases).

Hradčanská.description: arrives at stand D, departs from stand C

Bořislavka.description: arrives at stand D, departs from stand F

Karlovo náměstí.description: arrives at stand H, departs from stand G

Stadion Strahov.description: arrives at stand A, departs from stand B
